svg.title: What the series built, as six layers, each on top of the last. Part 1, tool calling: the model fills in a request, your code runs it. Part 2, StateGraph: nodes, edges, a shared state and reducers. Part 3, ReAct and memory: a model and tools loop, and a checkpointer. Part 4, Adaptive RAG and human-in-the-loop: route first, pause and edit. Part 5, Self-RAG and subgraphs: grade the documents and the answer, search in parallel. Part 6, Corrective RAG: refine to strips and fall back to the web.
